text:
Arshdeep Bains is an undrafted 25-year-old from Surrey, British Columbia, playing for his hometown Canucks. That part is a good story. The hockey has been tougher.

He has one goal and three points in 16 games, about 11 minutes a night on the fourth line. Vancouver gets only 44% of the expected goals with him on at five on five, though that's better than when he sits on a team that has struggled to control games. He's been on the ice for 4.3 fewer goals than the chances deserve, which hasn't helped.

He's a worker more than a shooter: seven shots in 16 games. The bottom of our wins-added list is mostly full of players like him, whose value doesn't show up in goals and saves.

His best junior season was 112 points in 68 WHL games in 2021-22, which is how he earned his way in. What to watch: whether he holds a lineup spot once the Canucks get healthier.
